paragraphs: LandApp lists land, ranches, farms and properties for sale from landowners, agents and brokers. Listings on the platform are enhanced with parcel data and analytics covering a property's features, revenue streams and risks. Owners can list unlimited properties for sale or for lease for solar, wind, carbon credits, data centers, recreation and agriculture at no cost.

Real estate agents and brokers can import listings to reach what the site calls a large network of potential buyers plus premium buyers. Those premium buyers are named as renewable energy developers, infrastructure developers and capital markets investors. Sellers can also present properties to a nationwide network of energy developers, capital markets investors and real estate professionals.

LandApp Pro is a subscription at $6 monthly covering ownership information, parcel data and 40+ map-based data layers for over 150 million properties. A free account carries three property due diligence reports, and the subscription creates unlimited reports. Listings on the marketplace carry value and risk index scores for potential buyers and property investors.

quote.text: List unlimited properties for sale or for lease at no cost and with no obligations to accept any offers.
